rationale: Both Robert and Bruno are deeply focused on ML infrastructure and data systems—Robert as CTO at Capes building data and ML infrastructure, and Bruno as Head of Platform at Amalgus Global orchestrating compute and inference systems. They share Python expertise and complementary angles on the same problem space: Robert's data science and ML project experience pairs well with Bruno's infrastructure, platform engineering, and SRE tooling focus, making them natural collaborators on scaling data-intensive systems.
intro_message: Robert Amanfu, meet Bruno — you're both solving the ML infrastructure puzzle from different angles (data science + ML ops vs. platform engineering + compute orchestration) and both code in Python, so you'll have a lot to unpack.
